name: Makinohara (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Makinohara city emblem in blue and green: a blue stylised wave swirl with green leaves.
history: Municipal flag of Makinohara, a city in Shizuoka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 19 March 2006.

features.role: Makinohara city emblem — a blue stylised wave swirl with green leaves
